baseline: Read-only file-name search over the user's local FerroSeek index. Use search_files to locate files by name or path fragments, get_file_info for metadata of a known path and index_status to see which directories are authorized. File contents are not available.

baseline.name: get_file_info
baseline.description: Get kind, size and modification time of one indexed file or directory inside an authorized directory, and whether the index is up to date for it. Does not read content.

path.description:
Absolute path of an indexed file or directory inside an authorized
directory.

exists.description: The path still exists on disk.

non_utf8.description:
The real path contains bytes that are not UTF-8; `path` is lossy.
Omitted when false (`default` keeps it optional in the schema).

path.description: Absolute path. Non-UTF-8 bytes are replaced (see `non_utf8`).

size.description: Size in bytes (files and symlinks only).

up_to_date.description:
The index metadata matches the file on disk (false while a change
is still being indexed, or if the file is gone).

baseline.name: index_status
baseline.description: Report whether the FerroSeek index is available, its size and last update, and which directories this server may search.

indexed.description: The directory is present in the FerroSeek index.

allowed_dirs.description: Directories this MCP server may expose.

available.description: The index database can be opened and queried.

indexed_files.description:
Totals for the whole index, including unauthorized directories.
Only reported when `expose_index_totals = true` in mcp.toml.

last_write.description: When the index was last written (UTC, RFC 3339); opt-in with totals.

baseline.name: search_files
baseline.description: Search indexed file and directory names (case-insensitive substrings; all words must match; a word containing '/' matches the path). Only directories the user authorized are searched. Returns paths with kind, size and modification time; does not read files.

limit.description: Maximum number of results (default 20, capped by the server).

query.description:
Words that must all appear in the file name (case-insensitive
substrings). A word containing '/' must appear in the full path.
Example: "invoice 2024" or "src/ main.rs".

root.description:
Absolute directory to search in; must be an authorized directory
or inside one. Default: all authorized directories.

Entry.description: One file or directory, as returned to agents.

non_utf8.description:
The real path contains bytes that are not UTF-8; `path` is lossy.
Omitted when false (`default` keeps it optional in the schema).

path.description: Absolute path. Non-UTF-8 bytes are replaced (see `non_utf8`).

size.description: Size in bytes (files and symlinks only).

incomplete_due_to_changes.description: Concurrent filesystem changes exhausted bounded retry work; refine or retry.

more_available.description: More matches exist than were returned (raise `limit` or refine).

omitted_stale.description: Lower bound on stale indexed matches observed and discarded.

truncated_by_size.description: Results were cut to keep the response small.

improved: Find files by name or partial path across indexed directories and repositories with search_files, without walking each repository. Authorized indexed paths only; no file-content search. Use rg for text; fd, rg --files or direct filesystem tools for new/unindexed files or complete live listings. Empty results do not prove absence. get_file_info checks known indexed paths; index_status diagnoses availability and authorization, not full coverage. Read-only, local stdio.

improved.name: get_file_info
improved.description: Inspect metadata and freshness of a known authorized indexed path, typically from search_files: kind, size, modification time, exists and up_to_date. Does not read file contents or follow symlinks. Not a general filesystem stat: for a new or unindexed path use direct filesystem tools within the user's permitted scope.

path.description:
Absolute authorized indexed path, typically returned by search_files.
Not a general filesystem stat: unknown or unauthorized paths are refused.

exists.description: The path still exists on disk.

non_utf8.description:
The real path contains bytes that are not UTF-8; `path` is lossy.
Omitted when false (`default` keeps it optional in the schema).

path.description: Absolute path. Non-UTF-8 bytes are replaced (see `non_utf8`).

size.description: Size in bytes (files and symlinks only).

up_to_date.description:
The index metadata matches the file on disk (false while a change
is still being indexed, or if the file is gone).

improved.name: index_status
improved.description: Diagnose index availability and MCP authorization when a search fails or its scope is unclear. Reports access mode, authorized boundaries and result cap; whole-index totals, size and last write time appear only if enabled by policy. Authorization is not indexed coverage: an allowed boundary need not itself be indexed. Does not enumerate all indexed roots or guarantee freshness/completeness. Optional, not a prerequisite for search_files.

indexed.description: The directory is present in the FerroSeek index.

allowed_dirs.description: Directories this MCP server may expose.

available.description: The index database can be opened and queried.

indexed_files.description:
Totals for the whole index, including unauthorized directories.
Only reported when `expose_index_totals = true` in mcp.toml.

last_write.description: When the index was last written (UTC, RFC 3339); opt-in with totals.

improved.name: search_files
improved.description: Find files and directories by filename or partial path, especially across multiple repositories or when their location is unknown. Searches an existing local index without walking each repository; only authorized indexed paths are visible. No file-content search: use rg for text in source files. For new or unindexed files, a complete live listing, or a simple known-directory lookup, fd, rg --files or direct filesystem tools may be preferable. Missing results do not prove a file is absent: indexing can lag and exclusions apply. Returns paths, kind, size and modification time; deleted entries are filtered. Query words are literal case-insensitive substrings, not glob/regex patterns; words containing '/' match paths. No status call is required first.

limit.description:
Maximum results (default 20, server policy cap, hard maximum 200).
Refine the query or increase this if more_available is true.

query.description:
Filename or partial path to find, not file contents. Space-separated
words are case-insensitive substrings that must all match: words with
'/' match the full path, other words match the name. No glob or regex
syntax. Examples: "invoice 2024", "src/ main.rs", "services/payments/".

root.description:
Optional absolute directory to narrow the search; omit for discovery
across all authorized indexed directories and repositories. Must be
authorized; cannot expand index coverage. No '.' or '..' components.

Entry.description: One file or directory, as returned to agents.

non_utf8.description:
The real path contains bytes that are not UTF-8; `path` is lossy.
Omitted when false (`default` keeps it optional in the schema).

path.description: Absolute path. Non-UTF-8 bytes are replaced (see `non_utf8`).

size.description: Size in bytes (files and symlinks only).

incomplete_due_to_changes.description: Concurrent filesystem changes exhausted bounded retry work; refine or retry.

more_available.description: More matches exist than were returned (raise `limit` or refine).

omitted_stale.description: Lower bound on stale indexed matches observed and discarded.

truncated_by_size.description: Results were cut to keep the response small.
